caseName: Arco Auto Carriers, Inc. v. Arkansas Ex Rel. Bruce Bennett, Attorney General
caseNameFull: ARCO AUTO CARRIERS, INC., Et Al. v. ARKANSAS Ex Rel. BENNETT, ATTORNEY GENERAL
attorneys: George S. Dixon and Louis Tarlowski for appellants., J. Frank Holt, Attorney General of Arkansas, and Bruce T. Bullion, Special Assistant Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
